scope: Computer science research subjects. Overlaps databases and graph-db, which hold this domain's standards and benchmarks; cs itself is for subject classification
gaps: Alignment measured once (research-kit DBMS V3, 2026-10-20): 9,444 of 28,598 extracted concepts grounded (33.0%); by kind, problems 40.9%, applications 47.2%, methods 31.6%, subjects 38.2%, metrics 14.4%, datasets/tools 10.1%. Same vocabularies on the earlier CS runs (2026-10-20): vectors 33.1% of 13,902, graph-learning 29.1% of 28,827, graphs 29.7% of 39,072. Not hand-checked (research-kit #6)
openalex-topics is not built under build/, so research-kit grounds on cso and acm-ccs only
acm-ccs licence is not stated by ACM; internal use until confirmed

acquire.manual: The download needs a signed-in CSO portal account. Sign in at cso.kmi.open.ac.uk, open Downloads, and take "Download .ttl" for v3.5.
acquire.notes: Released 2025-07-29. One Turtle file, 20.2 MB extracted, 166,518 triples, 14,636 cso:Topic. vocab_to_graph.py merges cso:preferentialEquivalent synonym clusters into their preferred topic (the others become aliases) and reads cso:superTopicOf as BROADER: 11,438 concepts, 18,658 BROADER edges. cso:contributesTo (48,980) and cso:relatedEquivalent are not hierarchy and are not emitted.

SKOS in RDF/XML. The file writes lang="en" where RDF/XML needs xml:lang; vocab_to_graph.py repairs it in memory. Identifiers are bare dotted paths, so convert with --base https://dl.acm.org/ccs2012/: 2,113 concepts, 2,100 BROADER edges, 13 top concepts. No licence is stated in the file or on dl.acm.org/ccs, whose page answers 403 to non-browser clients; the file itself downloads directly. Treat as internal use until the terms are confirmed with ACM.
